remembering.

Some stories don't begin with a grand entrance. Sometimes they begin with a few snaps, a birthday wish, and a conversation that quietly becomes the best notification of the day.

Before 26 October

We were already exchanging snaps. Little glimpses of our days, without knowing that these tiny moments would become part of a story.

26 October · Your birthday

28 October

Instagram, and then… us talking

That was the day we properly started talking on Instagram. Two days after your birthday—and perhaps the start of something lovely.

For your eyes only

A little note
from me to you.

I could have written this in a message, but you deserve a tiny dramatic reveal. Tap below.

Dear Hadika,

Happy belated birthday, Habibti. I know I wished you on the 26th, but a birthday wish can be a little late in becoming something special—and this is mine.

We started with snaps, then began talking properly on the 28th. We haven't met yet, and I won't pretend that we have a thousand memories together. But I like the little beginning we have: your messages, your pictures, your teasing, and the way you manage to make me jealous without even trying.

I hope this new year brings you happiness, good health, success in your studies, and all the things you quietly wish for. Do well in your exams. Keep smiling, keep being your mischievous self, and don't let the world make you any less you.

And one last thing: I may have stopped asking for pictures, but I haven't stopped looking forward to your messages.

With affection,
Zahid
♫
